records.claim: TeslatronPT with the standard integrated VTI: lowest documented sample temperature 1.5 K.
records.document_title: TeslatronPT - Integrated Cryofree superconducting magnet system (brochure, 2026)
records.location: PDF page 1, Features / Benefits bullet list
records.quote: Integrated variable temperature insert with static exchange gas around the sample, providing sample temperatures between 1.5 and 300 K while operating the magnet
records.reasoning: temperature.base (shape min, unit mK) is the documented lowest temperature; the standard VTI included in every configuration bottoms out at 1.5 K = 1500 mK. Same figure as ev_ox_0001 (temperature.range lower bound) but recorded under the separate temperature.base key that the experiments query.

records.claim: TeslatronPT optional KelvinoxJT dilution-refrigerator insert reaches below 25 mK; not part of the standard-VTI configurations.
records.document_title: TeslatronPT - Integrated Cryofree superconducting magnet system (brochure, 2026)
records.location: PDF page 1, Insert features and options
records.quote: < 25 mK with the cryogen free KelvinoxJT dilution refrigerator system
records.reasoning: The brochure lists KelvinoxJT as an insert option; the configurations are 'standard VTI' only, so this lower base temperature is optional_not_installed. 25 mK is the printed bound (conservative). Not sufficient for <= 20 mK requirements (transmon, MXC budget); would satisfy the <= 50 mK requirement of quantum_mk_vector_field_transport if fitted (KelvinoxJT compatibility with the 6/1/1 T vector magnet is not stated in the sources).
records.found_via: tavily_extract of brochure PDF; corroborated by oxinst.com quantum-measurement page

records.claim: Universal Measurement Probe (TeslatronPT option) can be pre-wired with 4 RF lines (UMP US wiring option TSTP-UMP-US-SIG).
records.document_title: Quantum Design Oxford - Products - Universal Measurement Probe (Tailored Probe Solutions for Electrical Transport Measurements)
records.location: Why Choose Universal Measurement Probe bullet list; Specifications table row 'UMP US Wiring (TSTP-UMP-US-SIG)', column RF Wiring = 4
records.quote: Pre-wired with configurable options of up to 38 DC lines (19 twisted pairs), 4 RF lines, optical fibres or driven guard wiring
records.reasoning: Vocabulary electrical.coax_lines = number of coaxial/RF lines to the sample; the UMP specification table gives RF Wiring = 4 for the US wiring option and 'No' for the DG wiring option. The configurations are named 'TeslatronPT, <magnet>, standard VTI' with a catalog-assumption basis; the TeslatronPT product page lists the Universal Measurement Probe under 'Options / Accessories', so the probe-dependent value is recorded as optional_not_installed. Does not meet the 124-line requirement of quantum_mxc_wiring_heat_budget; meets the optional >= 2 of quantum_transmon_characterization.

records.claim: Optical access to the sample is available only as optical-fibre wiring on the optional Universal Measurement Probe (US wiring, fibres optional); no cryostat windows are documented.
records.document_title: Quantum Design Oxford - Products - Universal Measurement Probe (Tailored Probe Solutions for Electrical Transport Measurements)
records.location: Introduction paragraph; Specifications table row 'UMP US Wiring', column Optical Fibres = Optional
records.quote: Various wiring options are available, including DC, RF, driven guard and optical fibres, allowing configurations to be tailored to specific experimental requirements.
records.reasoning: The only documented optical path to the sample is fibre wiring on the optional UMP (Specifications: Optical Fibres 'Optional' for US wiring, 'No' for DG wiring; comparison table: UMP best for 'Electrical transport/RF/Optical measurements'). This is fibre access, not free-space windows; experiments needing a free-space objective should treat it with care. The configurations are named 'TeslatronPT, <magnet>, standard VTI' with a catalog-assumption basis; the TeslatronPT product page lists the Universal Measurement Probe under 'Options / Accessories', so the probe-dependent value is recorded as optional_not_installed.

records.claim: Sample-in-vacuum environment is available with the optional Universal Measurement Probe (sample in helium exchange gas or vacuum); the standard VTI uses static exchange gas.
records.document_title: Quantum Design Oxford - Products - Universal Measurement Probe (Tailored Probe Solutions for Electrical Transport Measurements)
records.location: Features bullet list ('Sample Environment'); Specifications table column Sample Environment = Gas / Vacuum
records.quote: Sample Environment: helium exchange gas or vacuum
records.reasoning: The standard VTI places the sample in static exchange gas; vacuum around the sample requires the optional UMP (or the optional sample-in-vacuum HelioxVT insert; TeslatronPT Plus page: 'Sample-in-gas and sample-in vacuum options'). Hence flag true, optional_not_installed. The configurations are named 'TeslatronPT, <magnet>, standard VTI' with a catalog-assumption basis; the TeslatronPT product page lists the Universal Measurement Probe under 'Options / Accessories', so the probe-dependent value is recorded as optional_not_installed.
records.found_via: tavily_extract of UMP page; corroborated by TeslatronPT Plus page and brochure

records.claim: Electrical transport measurement (DC and AC lock-in up to 100 kHz via Lake Shore M81, Hall via M91) is offered through the TeslatronPT Plus upgrade; not part of the plain TeslatronPT configurations.
records.value_as_printed: low and high resistance, Hall effect, I-V; AC up to 100 kHz
records.location: Introducing TeslatronPT Plus, page 1 paragraph 3; Measurement Hardware section (Lake Shore M81)
records.quote: TeslatronPT Plus measurement capabilities include low and high resistance, Hall effect in Hall bar and van der Pauw geometries, and I-V characterisation.
records.reasoning: The TeslatronPT product page says the system can be upgraded 'by adding the enhanced measurement and control capabilities to bring up to our TeslatronPT Plus open architecture measurement standard'; the Plus brochure lists the M81 with 'the lock-in detection sensitivity of AC up to 100 kHz'. The configurations are plain TeslatronPT, so the transport module is optional_not_installed.
records.found_via: tavily_extract of TeslatronPT Plus brochure and TeslatronPT page
